title: Tinting with blend modes
summary: mix-blend-mode blends an element with what is behind it: multiply tints, screen lightens, difference inverts.
explanation: Normally an element covers what is behind it. mix-blend-mode mixes their colours instead, like layer modes in a photo editor. multiply darkens (white disappears, colours tint), screen lightens (black disappears), and difference inverts where they overlap.
Each tile has a striped background and an orange overlay on top. Only the blend mode differs, so compare them side by side.
Blending reaches through to everything behind, all the way up to the page. isolation: isolate on the tile stops the effect at the tile's edge.
tryThis: Change multiply to overlay, then to color.
Change the overlay colour to #2563eb on all tiles.
Change the tile stripes to linear-gradient(90deg, #18181b, #ffffff) and see how each mode treats the greys in between.
